uranus.conjunction: You are conservative and radical at the same time, and you build the new thing carefully enough that it survives.
uranus.harmonious: You can reform something without breaking it, which makes you unusually useful inside institutions that need changing.
uranus.square: You want security and escape simultaneously, so you construct careful arrangements and then blow them up.
uranus.opposition: The pressure to change and the pressure to stay come from different people, and you have been the one standing between them.

neptune.conjunction: You harden your dreams into something workable, or you let reality dissolve them, and there has rarely been a middle path.
neptune.harmonious: You can give a formless idea a structure, which is a rarer skill than it sounds and much of your value rests on it.
neptune.square: Your fears are vague and therefore unanswerable, and you have disciplined yourself against a threat you could never quite name.
neptune.opposition: Duty and longing pull against each other, usually with a person at each end, and neither has ever quite released you.

pluto.conjunction: You endure what other people would not, and the hardest years of your life built the part of you that works.
pluto.harmonious: You can rebuild from the foundations without flinching, and you are who people want in charge once it has gone badly.
pluto.square: You meet obstruction with force and force with obstruction, and a good deal of your energy has gone into the grinding.
pluto.opposition: Authority and power have come at you from outside, and what you learned from them was mostly how not to use them.

ascendant.conjunction: You come across as older and more contained than you are, and people have treated you as the responsible one since childhood.
ascendant.harmonious: Your manner is dependable and earns trust quickly, particularly from people who have to hand something over.
ascendant.square: You are read as guarded or unfriendly when you were only being careful, and it has cost you introductions.
ascendant.opposition: You attract people who set the terms, and much of your adult life has been about no longer needing their approval.

midheaven.conjunction: Your career is a long climb with real authority at the top of it, and nothing about it has come early.
midheaven.harmonious: You are trusted with responsibility because you have never yet dropped any, and your standing accumulates rather than arrives.
midheaven.square: Your ambitions keep meeting the limits of your circumstances, and you have started over later than most people do.
midheaven.opposition: Duty at home and duty at work have both claimed you, and you have felt like a failure at whichever one you set down.
